name: plausiden-site-contact-form
description: End-to-end contact form smoke. Lands on /contact, fills every form field with a synthetic-but-deliverable payload, submits, and asserts the acknowledgement page renders with the expected confirmation copy. Catches three failure modes the unit tests can't see: client-side script errors that block submit, server-side rate-limit / SMTP failure that surfaces as a non-2xx, and acknowledgement-page rendering regressions.

steps.value: Synthetic submission from PlausiDen-Crawler smoke journey. If you receive this, the contact form is working end-to-end. Safe to ignore.
